why_agent_cannot: identity verification is required and cannot be performed by an agent
what_human_must_do: Open engage.tbook.com and connect a Sui wallet. Check the address first: TBook's real sites all sit under tbook.com.
Link your wallets and your X, Telegram and Discord accounts to build your Incentive Passport and WISE Credit Score.

Do campaign tasks, press verify, then claim the SBT badge for each campaign. Warning Every SBT claim costs money. TBook's governance page says "A one-time claim fee is required to mint a TBook SBT", and the standard fee is 1.5 SUI plus gas. The disclaimer for its Telegram mini app says fees "are non-refundable".

Check the eligibility page at engage.tbook.com/book. Verify on Sui or on TON, never both. The TON version of the page warns that verifying on several networks "may trigger TBook's anti-Sybil mechanisms".
Decide whether the paid extras are worth it to you: Bookies NFTs, the RWA vaults, and Karma, a savings product with weekly prize draws.
costs: Linking accounts and doing tasks is free. Claiming each SBT costs 1.5 SUI plus gas at the standard rate. TBook's governance page says "30% of SBT claim fees will be distributed to Bookies NFT holders". Karma takes USDC deposits and locks them for 30 days.
